items.question: Does the final bundled build retain all schema6 history/local references and display A/B independently after migration?
items.why_hardware: Actual S25 provider and installed-app UI integration cannot be proven by the emulator alone.
items.observation: One install and normal connection; observe transferred-unconfirmed A and partial-review B; metadata-only comparison afterward.

criteria.PASS: History and reference bindings preserved; no invented resume/source proof; A/B labels distinct and accurate.
criteria.FAIL: Lost/changed references, false promotion or incorrect status binding.
criteria.INCONCLUSIVE: Device/provider/session unavailable or incomplete enumeration prevents applicable label observation.

items.engineering_decision: Determine whether production adapter/UI/migration needs correction; never infer gate PASS from labels.

items.new_hypothesis: Ledger-derived badges fix missing persistent status rendering.
competing_explanations: New callback or exact-identity binding still fails

items.question: Does Pocket expose an independently justifiable immutable source-version contract usable for resume?
items.why_hardware: Simulated immutable versions cannot establish DJI endpoint semantics.
prerequisites: No retroactive validator adoption for B
items.observation: Only new discriminating sanitized metadata evidence under the final session plan; no repeated playback-state question or automatic transfer.

criteria.PASS: Independent version/continuity contract is justified by specific evidence and its adapter tests; mere ETag presence is insufficient.
criteria.FAIL: Contradictory response/version behavior defeats the proposed contract.
criteria.INCONCLUSIVE: Metadata absent, ambiguous or semantics unsupported; retain safe refusal and overall UNVERIFIED.

items.engineering_decision: Enable no production append until its source/prefix contract is justified; otherwise retain capability unavailable.

batches.purpose: One installable build, one connection, two non-critical new-transfer observations and one shared restart; no repeated playback/rescan probes.
batches.decision_rule: A missing immutable source-version contract yields safe resume refusal and UNVERIFIED, never a false failure of file-integrity evidence.

excluded_redundant_observations: Playback running via DJI Mimo recurrence without a new distinguishing hypothesis
Repeated identical rescan for already-known partial enumeration
Standalone USB/ADB/UI checks while useful software work remains
